draft_en.subject: Industrial switches inside your kiosks and traffic cabinets
draft_en.body:
Hello AKIS team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 21 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches inside your queue-management kiosks and traffic cabinets, compact DIN-rail units, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, from single units: 8 x Gigabit unmanaged - model STI-080GE - $32.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 5 x Gigabit - STI-050GE - $17.8; 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged for fibre-linked cabinets - STI-280GE - $46.

One question: which port count do your cabinet designs use most - 5 or 8?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
